newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine state agency to raise $10 billion.
newsitem.headline: Philippine state agency to raise $10 billion.

text.p: The Philippine government's Bases Conversion Development Authority (Basecon) plans to raise about $10 billion within the next five years to finance its various infrastructure projects, an official said on Wednesday.
Jaime Ladao, a Basecon official, said the money would be used for the new international airport in Clark, a former U.S. military airbase, improvement of roads and railway projects.
"We're writing the business plans together right now with our financial advisor," Ladao said.
The BCDA recently chose a group of international financial institutions led by ABN-AMRO Bank as its global financial advisor.
The group includes Peregrine Capital Philippines Inc, Corporate Access Holdings and McKinsey & Co Inc.
Basecon is the main government agency in charge of privatising and developing former military camps in the country.
